units.text: Scientists deliberately tipped this floating laboratory upright. Why?
units.phonemes: sˈaɪəntɪsts dᵻlˈɪbɚɹətli tˈɪpt ðɪs flˈoʊɾɪŋ lˈæbɹətˌɔːɹi ˈʌpɹaɪt. wˈaɪ?
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.

units.text: Because when your instrument moves, it’s harder to tell what the ocean is doing.
units.phonemes: bɪkˈʌz wɛn jʊɹ ˈɪnstɹəmənt mˈuːvz, ɪts hˈɑːɹdɚ tə tˈɛl wʌt ðɪ ˈoʊʃən ɪz dˈuːɪŋ.
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.

units.text: FLIP was built to study underwater sound. Even a research submarine turned enough to limit those measurements.
units.phonemes: flˈɪp wʌz bˈɪlt tə stˈʌdi ˌʌndɚwˈɔːɾɚ sˈaʊnd. ˈiːvən ɐ ɹᵻsˈɜːtʃ sˈʌbmɚɹˌiːn tˈɜːnd ɪnˈʌf tə lˈɪmɪt ðoʊz mˈɛʒɚmənts.
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.

units.text: So engineers made a laboratory that travelled horizontally, then flooded ballast tanks to lower its stern.
units.phonemes: sˌoʊ ˌɛndʒɪnˈɪɹz mˌeɪd ɐ lˈæbɹətˌɔːɹi ðæt tɹˈævəld hˌɔːɹɪzˈɔntəli, ðˈɛn flˈʌdᵻd bˈæləst tˈæŋks tə lˈoʊɚɹ ɪts stˈɜːn.
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.

units.text: The lab stayed above water, while about ninety metres of hull extended beneath it.
units.phonemes: ðə lˈæb stˈeɪd əbˌʌv wˈɔːɾɚ, wˌaɪl ɐbˌaʊt nˈaɪndi mˈiːɾɚz ʌv hˈʌl ɛkstˈɛndᵻd bᵻnˈiːθ ɪt.
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.

units.text: Look at the shape: a narrow section near the surface, with a broader hull deep below.
units.phonemes: lˈʊk æt ðə ʃˈeɪp: ɐ nˈæɹoʊ sˈɛkʃən nˌɪɹ ðə sˈɜːfɪs, wɪð ɐ bɹˈɔːdɚ hˈʌl dˈiːp bᵻlˈoʊ.

units.text: In deep water, the motion caused by surface waves weakens with depth.
units.phonemes: ɪn dˈiːp wˈɔːɾɚ, ðə mˈoʊʃən kˈɔːzd baɪ sˈɜːfɪs wˈeɪvz wˈiːkənz wɪð dˈɛpθ.
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.

units.text: FLIP’s shape made it much less responsive to those waves.

units.text: It could still drift and tilt. Stable didn’t mean motionless.

units.text: They tipped the laboratory upright to make a moving ocean easier to measure.
